Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer stunning panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff dressed in traditional Swiss attire make every visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your website (www.dora-website.com). I took a look at it — it's a nice, clean personal site that clearly introduces you and makes it easy for visitors to get in touch via your e-mail. A couple of suggestions to make it even stronger: consider adding a short bio or a few interests/hobbies so visitors get a better sense of who you are, and maybe include some links to your other profiles or projects. Overall, a solid personal homepage — keep it up!

Hi Eve! Thanks for sharing your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I enjoyed reading it — it's a friendly, approachable blog, and I love that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby; that personal touch really gives the blog its character. To make it even more engaging, you could add some photos or descriptions from your hikes, share a few more recent posts, and include links to your other social profiles. A great start to a personal blog — looking forward to seeing more!
